plan.title: [framework-gap] Antigravity PreToolUse hook blocks writes to host artifact directory (~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<conversation-id>) as a configuration area

narratives.Description: [framework-gap] Antigravity PreToolUse hook blocks writes to host artifact directory (~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<conversation-id>) as a configuration area
narratives.Overview:
## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A write whose every target is under `~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<conversationId>/`, where `<conversationId>` is the applying agy session's conversation id, is treated as outside every checkout and needs no occupancy, gated ritual or active scope.
- [ ] A write under another conversation's folder, or anywhere else under `~/.gemini` (for example `~/.gemini/config/`), is still treated as a configuration area and gated as today.
- [ ] The carve-out applies only when the applying host is agy and the conversation id is known; with no agy identity the path is gated as today.
- [ ] Path matching uses the shared canonical path identity (case, slash and 8.3 forms on win32), and a `..` or symlink escape out of the conversation folder is not admitted.
- [ ] Tests cover the allowed current-conversation write, a sibling conversation write, a `config/` write, and an escape attempt.

issueCommentThread.body:
Rewriting the body to criteria-only for ingest. Scott: "add both to 0.132.1" (with #7446). Operator decision for the carve-out: allow pre-ritual writes **only** under the current Antigravity conversation folder, `~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<conversationId>/`, where `<conversationId>` matches the applying session; every other path under `~/.gemini` (including `config/` and the deposited hook files) stays a protected configuration area. No arc. Prior body quoted below.

<details><summary>Prior body</summary>

## Summary

Antigravity PreToolUse hook blocks writes to host artifact directory (~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<conversation-id>) as a configuration area

## Context

Directive 0.132.0 on Antigravity (agy 1.5.18, win32) with live PreToolUse hooks active (internal benchmark evidence (private)). Calling Antigravity write_file targeting the host conversation artifact directory (~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<conversation-id>/scratch/probe.txt) while in read-only or pre-ritual posture.

## Expected behavior

Writes scoped to the current Antigravity conversation artifact directory (~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<conversation-id>/...) are allowed without requiring repository occupancy or a gated session ritual (similar to OS temp / outside-every-checkout writes under #6376), so Antigravity can create plans, walkthroughs, and scratch artifacts during read-only or pre-ritual turns.

## Actual behavior / gap

PreToolUse denies write_file into ~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/<conversation-id>/... and routes it through full repository mutation gates (occupancy + gated session ritual + active scope). Root cause: outside-every-checkout.js classifies any first path segment under home starting with '.' (.gemini) as 'inside a configuration area' (locationVerdict), so allTargetsOutsideEveryCheckout returns false even though write_file to OS temp passes the same check.

## Session notes

Observed in live AGY 1.5.18 session under flat SessionStart hook schema (Refs #6376, #7346, #7440). A narrow carve-out for the active host conversation artifact subtree (not all of ~/.gemini) would keep ~/.gemini config files protected while letting Antigravity write its own conversation artifacts. Source: internal benchmark evidence (private).

---
_Filed via `deft feedback:file` from a directive consumer project (Refs #1709 value-feedback gap escalation)._



</details>
